summary: Fury Gold Mines filed a Form 6-K furnishing a November 3, 2026 press release reporting first assay results from its 2026 diamond drill program at the Committee Bay gold project in Nunavut. Highlights include 3.88 g/t Au over 17.82 m (including 18.78 g/t over 3.30 m) in hole 26TB158 and 0.77 g/t over 98.60 m in hole 26TB161. All five reported holes hit the Three Bluffs shear zone. Results will feed an upcoming mineral resource update. This is routine exploration disclosure, not a special situation; watch resource-update timing and pending assays.
